description: This file defines a configuration structure and functions for logging verbosity and flags in the Kubernetes testing context, including the 'Config' class, related options, and flag registration.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration for logging in test logger, including verbosity and vmodule settings.

methods.name: Verbosity
methods.description: Returns a flag.Value instance for querying or setting verbosity threshold.

methods.name: VModule
methods.description: Returns a flag.Value instance for querying or setting vmodule settings.

methods.name: AddFlags
methods.description: Registers command line flags for verbosity and vmodule.
